definitions.explanation: A plan or scheme, often with a nuance of something ambitious, secretive, or potentially underhanded. Can refer to both positive undertakings and negative plots.

examples.japanese: {企|くわだ}て⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{大胆|だいたん}→大胆：07609_daitan⟧な{企|くわだ}て⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実行|じっこう}→実行：03274_jikkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}す→移す：10122_utsusu⟧。
examples.english: To put a bold plan into action.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{企|くわだ}て⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{事前|じぜん}→事前：07580_jizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}して→発覚する：15423_hakkakusuru⟧⟦{未然|みぜん}→未然：13084_mizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{防|ふせ}がれた→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧。
examples.english: His plot was discovered beforehand and prevented.

notes:
The noun form of the verb {企|くわだ}てる (to plan, to scheme). While it can refer to neutral or positive plans, it often carries a nuance of ambition, secrecy, or cunning — closer to English "scheme" or "plot" than a simple "plan."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {企|くわだ}て⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実行|じっこう}する→実行する：22146_jikkousuru⟧: to carry out a plan
- {企|くわだ}て⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: for a plan to fail
- {企|くわだ}て⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}する→発覚する：15423_hakkakusuru⟧: for a plot to be discovered
- ⟦{大胆|だいたん}→大胆：07609_daitan⟧な{企|くわだ}て: a bold scheme

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧: plan — neutral and general-purpose; the most common word for "plan"
- ⟦{陰謀|いんぼう}→陰謀：10887_inbou⟧: conspiracy — stronger negative connotation, implies a hidden group effort
- ⟦{企画|きかく}→企画：04879_kikaku⟧: project/planning — used in business contexts for project proposals
